novel_features.name: Cross-community FTS
novel_features.description: Search across every community's messages, issues, agreements, and timeline posts from one terminal.
novel_features.rationale: Chainels' web UI scopes search to a single community at a time; FTS5 over the local synced corpus searches every community at once.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when you need to find one tenant note, one issue, or one agreement across many properties without round-trips to the API.

novel_features.name: Issue assignee load
novel_features.description: Group open issues by assignee with age buckets so you can spot who's drowning before sprint planning.
novel_features.rationale: The /issues endpoint returns flat lists; assignee × age-bucket grouping requires a local join the API doesn't expose.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when a property manager asks who has the oldest issues open or which assignee needs help before Monday triage.

novel_features.name: Stale issue digest
novel_features.description: List issues with no state transition for N days across every community.
novel_features.rationale: The API has no "stale" predicate; the local store's updated_at column makes this a single filter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when a community manager needs a Monday escalation list across a portfolio.

novel_features.name: Turnover variance
novel_features.description: Compute per-tenant variance vs trailing-N-month median for retail turnover reports.
novel_features.rationale: Chainels exposes /turnover/.../statistics aggregates but not per-tenant variance against the tenant's own history; computed locally over synced reports.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when a landlord wants to spot a tenant whose sales dropped relative to that tenant's own normal.

novel_features.name: Turnover laggards
novel_features.description: List tenants who haven't submitted a turnover report for a given period.
novel_features.rationale: Set-difference between expected submitters (turnover schemes + members) and actual reports; the API has no "who hasn't submitted" endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this on the 6th of every month to chase the missing submissions across a portfolio.

novel_features.name: Agreement renewals
novel_features.description: List lease/agreement records whose end-of-term falls inside an N-day window.
novel_features.rationale: Filtering by renewal window across communities requires a local index; the API lists agreements per community.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when a renewal calendar is needed by Friday and the manager has more than one community to sweep.

novel_features.name: Member-load audit
novel_features.description: Per-account role count across entities + flag duplicates and orphans.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced accounts + account-entity-roles + community members; the API forces N+1 round trips.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an integrator (Yardi/Entrata) is reconciling who has what role and where, and the answer must be machine-readable.

novel_features.name: Alarm recipient diff
novel_features.description: Diff alarm-configuration recipient lists between two communities or two snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: API returns alarm config; the diff itself is local set algebra on synced rows.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when checking drift between sister buildings or before/after a config change.

novel_features.name: Since-sync changed
novel_features.description: Union of rows where synced_at >= --since, grouped by resource, across the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Delta sync without per-resource polling — one local query unifies every resource's updated_at column.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this for integrators (Yardi/Entrata) who run weekly deltas and need a single "what's new" report across resources.

narrative.headline: Every Chainels endpoint as a typed command, plus the cross-community search, turnover variance, and stale-issue digests the web UI cannot give you.
narrative.value_prop: Chainels' web UI scopes everything to one community at a time. This CLI syncs every community you can see into a local SQLite store and adds the joins that matter: cross-community FTS, issue-assignee load, turnover laggards/variance, agreement renewals, member-load audit, alarm diffs. Live API calls flow through OAuth2 client_credentials so it works headless in CI and agent contexts.
narrative.auth_narrative: Chainels uses OAuth 2.0 with three grant types: client_credentials for userless app access (recommended for this CLI; set CHAINELS_CLIENT_ID + CHAINELS_CLIENT_SECRET), authorization_code for user delegation, and a group_token grant that issues a token scoped to a group. Tokens are cached in the local config so the access_token endpoint isn't hit on every call.

quickstart.comment: Confirm OAuth credentials, demo/prod reachability, and local store state.
Pull every community, account, message, issue, agreement, and turnover report into the local SQLite store.
Grep across every synced community at once.
Monday triage list of stale issues across the portfolio.
Who hasn't filed for the current period.

troubleshoots.fix: Confirm CHAINELS_CLIENT_ID and CHAINELS_CLIENT_SECRET come from the same Chainels OAuth app, then run chainels-pp-cli doctor to re-fetch.
The OAuth app may lack the required scope (write.messages, read.turnover). Check the app's scopes in the Chainels developer console.
Run chainels-pp-cli sync --full first; search reads from the local store and is empty until sync populates it.
Set CHAINELS_BASE_URL=https://demo.chainels.com/api/v2 to point at demo; default is prod.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for chainels-pp-cli when you manage more than one Chainels community and need answers the web UI can't produce in one query — cross-community search, who-hasn't-submitted lists, renewal calendars, and member-load audits. It is also the right tool for Yardi/Entrata integrators who need a delta-sync primitive and machine-readable joins between agreements, accounts, and roles.
